strings.sat.desc.iss: Ko e fokotuʻu lahi taha ʻoku nofo ʻi ai ha kakai ʻi he vahaʻa fuʻu lahi. ʻOku nofo maʻu ai ha kulupu kau ʻeva fakalangi, pea ʻoku takatakai ia ʻo Māmani ʻi he miniti 92 nai. ʻOku hoko mai ko e tuʻunga maama taha ʻoku hāʻele ʻi he langi ʻi he pō.
strings.sat.desc.css: Ko e senitā ʻi he vahaʻa fuʻu lahi ʻa Siaina, kuo nofo ʻi ai talu mei he 2021. ʻOku siʻisiʻi hifo ia ʻi he Senitā Fakavahaʻapuleʻanga, ka ʻi ha ngaahi founga lelei, ʻoku ofi ke tatau ʻa e maama.
strings.sat.desc.hst: Ko ha sioʻata mamaʻo fakalangi naʻe fakalele ʻi he 1990 naʻe fakakehe ʻa e meʻa ʻoku tau ʻiloʻi ki he māmani fuʻu lahi. Naʻe puʻaki ʻe ia ha ngaahi galaxy ʻoku mamaʻo ʻaupito pea tokoniʻi ke fua pe ʻoku fakatuputupu vave fēfē ʻa e māmani fuʻu lahi.
strings.sat.desc.acs3: Ko ha satelaiti ʻahiʻahi ʻa NASA ʻoku ʻi ai ha laʻā laʻā ʻoku fuofua ʻi he 80 m², ʻoku fakaueʻi tokotaha pē ʻe he mafana ʻo e maama ʻa e laʻā. ʻOku ngali maama ia ʻi hono lahi koeʻuhi ko ʻene laʻā ngingila.
strings.sat.desc.envisat: Ko ha satelaiti ʻEulope ki he sio ki Māmani, ʻoku fuofua tatau mo ha pasi. Naʻe mole ʻa e fetuʻutaki mo ia ʻi he 2012, pea talu mei ai ʻoku kei ʻi he takatakai ko e taha ʻo e ngaahi konga fuʻu lahi taha ʻo e ʻotoʻota vahaʻa fuʻu lahi.
strings.sat.desc.amos: Ko e fā ʻo e ngaahi satelaiti fetuʻutaki ʻa ʻIsileli. ʻOku nau ʻi he māʻolunga ʻi he 36,000 kilomita nai, ko ia ʻoku nau hā mai ʻo ngali tuʻu maʻu ʻi ha konga ʻe taha ʻo e langi. ʻOku ʻikai lava ke sio ki ai ʻaki ha mata noa, ka ʻoku fakahā ʻe he ʻapps honau hala.
strings.sat.desc.eros: Ko ha satelaiti ʻIsileli ki he puʻaki fakaʻata ʻoku māʻolunga ʻa hono lelei, ʻoku puleʻi ʻe ImageSat, naʻe fakalele ʻi he 2022.
strings.sat.desc.venus: Ko ha satelaiti fakatotolo ʻIsileli-Falanisē naʻe fakalele ʻi he 2017 naʻe puʻaki ha ngaahi ʻakau mo ngaahi ngoue ke muimui ai ʻa e ngaahi liliu ʻo e ʻatakai.
strings.sat.desc.cat.weather: Ko ha satelaiti ʻo e ʻea ʻoku hoko atu ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he ongo pola. ʻOku ne puʻaki ha ngaahi ʻao, ngaahi afā, mo e mafana, pea ʻoku tokoniʻi ʻe hono fakamatala ʻa e kikite ʻo e ʻea.
strings.sat.desc.cat.observation: Ko ha satelaiti ʻoku puʻaki ʻa e funga ʻo Māmani — ngaahi vao, ngaahi koló, ngaahi ʻotai, mo e ʻaisi — ke muimui pe ʻoku liliu fēfē ia ʻi he taimi.
strings.sat.desc.cat.science: Ko ha satelaiti naʻe langa ke fakatotolo ʻaki ʻa e vahaʻa fuʻu lahi pe ko Māmani. ʻOku ʻikai kei ngāue ʻa honau niʻihi, ka ʻoku nau kei ʻi he takatakai.
strings.sat.desc.cat.telescope: Ko ha sioʻata mamaʻo fakalangi ʻoku ne vakai ki he māmani fuʻu lahi mei ʻolunga ʻi he ʻea, ʻaia ʻoku ne kai ʻa e lahi taha ʻo e maama ʻoku hoko mai mei he vahaʻa fuʻu lahi.
strings.sat.desc.cat.communication: Ko ha satelaiti ʻoku ne fakahoko atu ʻa e televisone, initaneti, mo e ngaahi telefoni. ʻOku puna māʻolunga ʻaupito ʻa honau tokolahi, ko ia ʻoku siʻi pē ʻoku lava ke sio ki ai ʻaki ha mata noa.
strings.sat.desc.cat.starlink: Ko e taha ʻo e ngaahi afe ʻo e satelaiti Starlink ʻa SpaceX, ʻoku ne ʻomai ha initaneti mei he vahaʻa fuʻu lahi. ʻOku puna māʻulalo, ko ia ʻoku faingofua ke sio ki ai, pea ʻi he taimi ʻe niʻihi ʻoku nau hāʻele ʻi ha laine lōloa, taha hili taha.
strings.sat.desc.cat.rocket: Ko hono konga ʻolunga ʻo ha rokete, ʻaia naʻe ʻave ʻa e satelaiti ki hono takatakai pea toe nofo ia ʻi ai. ʻOku lahi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ni pea ʻoku nau laʻā ngingila ʻi he tuʻo lahi, ko ia ʻoku ofi ke faingofua ke sio ki ai.
strings.identify.proMore: ʻOku toe ʻiloʻi ʻe he Pro ʻa e fetuʻu, kulupu fetuʻu, mo e meʻa vahaʻa fuʻu lahi loloto takitaha.
